name: Shan
notes: Shan (တႆး, Tai Long), a Southwestern Tai (Tai-Kadai) language of Shan State, Myanmar, ~3-4 million speakers, the majority/regional language of Shan State. Script: the modern reformed Shan alphabet (Unicode Myanmar block, 1950s systematic-tone-marking reform) — a Burmese-derived ABUGIDA whose 19 base consonant letters carry an inherent /a/ (declared via `inherent_vowel`), modified by dependent vowel signs and, distinctively, by dedicated TONE-MARK letters at the end of the syllable. GRAPHEME KEYS: consonants and vowel signs follow the standard letter chart ('Shan alphabet', Wikipedia; consonant IPA cross-checked against PHOIBLE's shan1277 inventory) -- note `သ`, Burmese θ historically, is repurposed in Shan for /s/, not /θ/ (Shan has no /θ/ in its PHOIBLE inventory), and `ရ`, historically /r/, is kept polysemous /j~l/ reflecting the well-documented Tai r>y/l merger rather than invented as a third, unattested consonant. TONE MARKS earn grapheme keys under design-constraint test 2: each mark spells a single suprasegmental unit (one lexical tone), not a concatenable segment, exactly the way this dataset already treats stress marks and vowel length; the five tone-mark keys here (rising is the UNMARKED default, so five marks cover the remaining five of six tones Wikipedia's Shan-language article describes for unchecked syllables) are mapped to the IPA pitch contours the source gives (rising ˨˦ unmarked / low ˩ / mid-falling ˧˨ / high ˥ / high-falling-creaky ˦˨ˀ / emphatic ˧˦˧). KNOWN GAP, documented rather than resolved by guessing: checked (stopped) syllables contrast only FOUR tones by the cited source, and the mark-to-tone correspondence in that environment is not yet split out with a `positional_graphemes`/coda-conditioned rule -- left for a follow-up cited pass. STRESS: Shan is a tone language without a separate stress system in the cited sources; no `stress` block, a documented exemption (tone marks carry the prosodic information instead). SMOKE CHECKS against `shn_mymr_broad.tsv` (WikiPron, broad transcription): ငဝ်း -> gold 'ŋ a w ˥' (ξ=ŋ, inherent a, ဝ=w, း=˥ high tone, matches); ငိင်း -> gold 'ŋ i ŋ ˥' (င=ŋ, ိ=i, coda ‌င=ŋ, း=˥, matches); ငူဝ်း -> gold 'ŋ oː ˥' (င=ŋ, ူ=oː, ဝ်=silent killed-w coda per the source's 'killed consonant' convention, း=˥, matches). TIER: `research` -- sourced (PHOIBLE; Wikipedia Shan alphabet/language), tone-as-prosody exemption documented, and `shn_mymr_broad.tsv` (2607 rows, WikiPron/Wiktionary scrape, `crowd-scraped` provenance, registered below) is scored in `scripts/benchmark.py` with a PER recorded in `benchmarks/results.json`.
